plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Computer Science BS graduation plan text PDF. Semester totals as printed: 15 / 14 / 15 / 12 / 16 / 15 / 15 / 15 = 117, matching the printed 'Total Hours 117'. Course titles verified against the program's 2025-2026 curriculum (computer-science-bs.pdf): CS 1400 Fundamentals of Programming; CS 1410 Object Oriented Programming; CS 2100 Discrete Structures; CS 2420 Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures; CS 2450 Software Engineering; CS 2810 Computer Organization and Architecture; CS 3005 Programming in C++; CS 3150 Computer Networks; CS 3400 Operating Systems; CS 3410 Distributed Systems; CS 3510 Algorithms; CS 3520 Programming Languages; CS 3530 Computational Theory; CS 4300 Artificial Intelligence; CS 4307 Database Systems; CS 4600 Senior Project; SE 1400 Web Design Fundamentals (ALCS); SE 3200 Web Application Development I; BIOL 1610 Principles of Biology I (LS); BIOL 1615 Principles of Biology I Lab (LAB); MATH 1210 Calculus I (MA); MATH 2270 Linear Algebra; MATH 3400 Probability & Statistics; ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 1010D Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'CS Core Elective (N of 7 courses)' slots are choice placeholders (numbered) — the plan's printed examples are (CS 4307), (CS 3520), (CS 3400), (CS 3150), (SE 3200), (CS 4300), (CS 3410); catalog options: CS 3150, CS 3400, CS 3410, CS 3520, CS 3600, CS 4300, CS 4307, CS 4320, CS 4550, SE 3200. 'CS Elective (N of 3 courses)' slots are choice placeholders (numbered) — plan example for #1 is (SE 1400); catalog CS elective options include CS 3150, CS 3400, CS 3410, CS 3500, CS 3520, CS 3600, CS 4300, CS 4307, CS 4320, CS 4400, CS 4410, CS 4550, IT 1100, IT 2700, IT 3100, IT 3110, IT 4200, SE 3010, SE 3020, SE 3100, SE 3150, SE 3200, SE 3400, SE 3450 and others. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
